import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Rudin_exercise_5_6
  {f : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hf1 : ContinuousOn f (Set.Ici 0))
  (hf2 : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioi 0))
  (hf3 : f 0 = 0)
  (hf4 : MonotoneOn (deriv f) (Set.Ioi 0)) :
  MonotoneOn (λ x => f x / x) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
  intro x hx y hy hle
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hle with rfl | hlt
  · exact le_rfl
  have hx0 : 0 < x := hx
  have hy0 : 0 < y := hy
  have h0x_sub : Set.Icc 0 x ⊆ Set.Ici 0 := Set.Icc_subset_Ici_self
  have h0x_sub_o : Set.Ioo 0 x ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := fun _ hc => hc.1
  have hxy_sub : Set.Icc x y ⊆ Set.Ici 0 := fun z hz => le_trans (le_of_lt hx0) hz.1
  have hxy_sub_o : Set.Ioo x y ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := fun z hz => lt_trans hx0 hz.1
  
  have hMVT1 := exists_deriv_eq_slope f hx0 (hf1.mono h0x_sub) (hf2.mono h0x_sub_o)
  rcases hMVT1 with ⟨c1, hc1, hc1_eq⟩
  have hMVT2 := exists_deriv_eq_slope f hlt (hf1.mono hxy_sub) (hf2.mono hxy_sub_o)
  rcases hMVT2 with ⟨c2, hc2, hc2_eq⟩
  
  rw [hf3, sub_zero, sub_zero] at hc1_eq
  have hc1_in : c1 ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := hc1.1
  have hc2_in : c2 ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := lt_trans hx0 hc2.1
  have hc1_le_c2 : c1 ≤ c2 := le_trans (le_of_lt hc1.2) (le_of_lt hc2.1)
  have hderiv_le : deriv f c1 ≤ deriv f c2 := hf4 hc1_in hc2_in hc1_le_c2
  
  rw [hc1_eq, hc2_eq] at hderiv_le
  have hx_pos : 0 < x := hx0
  have hyx_pos : 0 < y - x := sub_pos.mpr hlt
  have h1 : f x * (y - x) ≤ (f y - f x) * x := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hx_pos hyx_pos] at hderiv_le
    exact hderiv_le
  have h2 : f x * y ≤ f y * x := by
    linarith
  have hxy_pos : 0 < x * y := mul_pos hx0 hy0
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hx_pos hy0]
  linarith
